asset.name: Tooltip
asset.description: The concise explanatory overlay with hover intent, keyboard activation, an explicit touch policy, shared delay grouping, collision handling, and description rather than label semantics.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Background and elevation come from the shared surface primitive rather than per-overlay shadow values.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and reduced-motion collapse are owned once.
Hover intent, delay, and pointer-type awareness are shared.

rationale: Deliberately not built on Popover: a tooltip must never take focus, and inheriting Popover's focus management is how tooltips end up trapping keyboard users.
